title.narrative: Provision of lifesaving NFIs and Plastic Sheets to the El Niño floods displaced persons in Berdale district, Bay region.

description.narrative: ltpgtSomalia is facing a once-in-a-century flooding with over 1.7M people affected, damaging critical infrastructure including roads, bridges and approximately 1.5 million hectares of farmland potentially being destroyed. Increased rainfall is forecasted due to a concurrence of El Niño conditions and according to the Food and Agriculture Organization’s Somali Water and Land Information Management projects, flooding of such magnitude is statistically likely only once in 100 years, with significant anticipated humanitarian impacts.lt/pgtltpgtAbove-normal rainfall is expected to persist until the end of 2023, exacerbating the already grave humanitarian situation, whereby 4.3 million people, a quarter of the population are expected to face crisis-level hunger or worse by the end of 2023 underscoring the urgent need for humanitarian aid and funding.lt/pgtltpgt ltbrgtConcerted efforts by humanitarian actors, donors, the government, and other stakeholders are needed to mitigate the impacts of such destructive flooding. However, early warning and early action can save lives and livelihoods, but large-scale displacement, increased humanitarian needs, and further destruction of property remains the greatest risks facing the population.lt/pgtltpgtltbrgtRecent Multi-sector Rapid Needs assessment conducted in Berdale (attached) indicate that the people displaced by the floods lack NFIs and Shelter support that are essential for their survival. Therefore, Through this project, CESDO aims to improve living conditions, provide protection from hazardous weather conditions, and enhance privacy, safety, and dignity of the El Nino floods affected persons in Berdale by providing standard NFIs and 2 additional plastic sheets to 2,200 HHs approximately 13,200 people (5,300 women, 2,600 girls, 3,200 men and 2,100 boys). The same households (2,200) receiving NFI kits will also receive 2 plastic sheets each.lt/pgtltpgt lt/pgtltpgtCESDO has also secured WASH and CCCM funding enabling it to operate in close collaboration and complementarily with these sectors and others like Health, Protection and FSL to ensure strengthened, holistic, integrated response and inclusion of the most vulnerable populations including minority and marginalized groups, persons with disabilities, elderly, women and children. ltbrgtlt/pgt
